parameters.query:
SELECT
  message->>'content' AS content
FROM public.n8n_chat_histories
WHERE session_id = '{{ $('HappyFlops - Seg. Rebeca').item.json.id }}'
  AND message->>'type' = 'ai'
  AND message ? 'content'              -- garantiza que existe la clave
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1;
